_comment: spine_reach's start (FIXTURE-FIRST). 2026-07-26 main-quest spec 4, Phase 6: the pilgrimage spine's own canonical. Derived from near_riverfarm (same Act III backbone, same mounted-and-awakened door) and moved to Liscor's market street at Pisces's elbow, with ALL THREE region chains already CLOSED so every capstone arm's real gate is armed and every arm is exercised from the position spec 8 cares about -- a save whose regional quests are long finished. That is the point of this fixture: the arms are REVISIT surfaces, not chain tails, and a fixture that arrived mid-chain would prove the easy case. Riverfarm: blight_lifted/mediated_the_debt/persuaded_someone = riverfarm_talk's TALK resolution, price_of_a_favor_reported = the headman's report. Invrisil: the a_gentlemans_disagreement terminal set, copied from inn_guests_ext_start. Pallass: papers_for_pallass + forge_tier_permit closed, ditto. Both attunement stones held (the coherence validator demands the Invrisil one; the Pallass one keeps the pair honest). met_pisces added alongside learned_magic_from_pisces (near_riverfarm omits it, but the lesson chain's own entry option banks it -- nothing reaches learned_magic without it). chatted_with_pisces and chatted_with_grimalkin deliberately ABSENT: the first keeps Pisces's fence topic hidden so his greet list stays short and exactly pinnable, the second lets the run prove Grimalkin's met-counter banks off the new arm. gold 11 mirrors inn_guests_ext_start's post-chain purse (the forge chain's 16g of fees is paid). TRAP: rng_state is near_riverfarm's derived seed-9 state, never a hand-typed seed; this fixture resolves no combat.
